senses.gloss: m. (= היי דן, v. הַיְידָּא) which now? who? Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ top ה׳ וינון (read יינון or אינון) which are they?; [Y. Erub. III, 20ᵈ top אילין אינון, read: אַיְילֵן].—
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:4:3">Y. Dem. II, 23ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ ר׳ מאיר</he>, v. <cite ref="E00328"><he>הֵי</he> II</cite>.—Y. Sabb. XIX, 17ᵇ (also <he>היי דין</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 2:1:4">Y. Gitt. II, 44ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ה׳ הוא למחר</he> what is meant by ‘to-morrow’ (the next following or the day after the next)?; a. fr.
